description: This file initializes the React application, rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the React DOM root and wraps the App component in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree into a specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the root DOM node.
